name: Clifton Commons
summary: Clifton Commons is a community shopping center on Route 3 featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, restaurants, and banking services. The center's standout amenity is its 16-screen movie theater, making it a popular destination for both shopping and entertainment in northern New Jersey.
demographics: Clifton Commons attracts a diverse, middle-class demographic from the densely populated Passaic County area, with a strong representation of families and working professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves a multicultural community with above-average household incomes, drawing shoppers from Clifton, Passaic, and surrounding northern New Jersey suburbs. Visitors typically engage in convenience-oriented shopping trips, combining errands at the grocery anchor with entertainment at the 16-screen theater and casual dining experiences.
description: Clifton Commons stands as a prominent community shopping destination in northern New Jersey, strategically located on Route 3 in Clifton. This open-air shopping center has established itself as a convenient one-stop destination for the surrounding communities, anchored by essential retail services and complemented by a substantial entertainment component. The center's 16-screen movie theater serves as a major draw, making it a popular evening and weekend destination for families and moviegoers throughout Passaic County. Beyond entertainment, Clifton Commons offers a practical mix of national retailers, banking services, and diverse dining options that cater to the area's multicultural population. The center's accessible location along a major thoroughfare, combined with ample parking and a tenant mix focused on everyday needs, has made it a reliable shopping hub for residents seeking convenience without traveling to larger regional malls.
